##### Project general facts

Damac District is a contemporary residential project located within the master community of Damac Hills in Dubai. The development offers a collection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments that emphasize modern architecture, functional layouts, and strong visual connection to the surrounding landscaped greens, water features, and golf community environment. Positioned within an established and well-planned suburban district, the project benefits from a calm residential atmosphere while maintaining convenient access to major road networks and key destinations across Dubai.

The project is integrated into a broader lifestyle-focused community that offers a wide range of leisure and wellness amenities. Residents benefit from access to private dining pods, BBQ stations, and an organic-style swimming pool, alongside extensive fitness and recreation facilities such as a state-of-the-art gym with AI-powered training systems, padel courts, outdoor calisthenics zones, and an indoor golf simulator. In addition, dedicated children’s play areas and family-oriented recreational spaces create a well-balanced environment designed to support both active living and relaxation for all age groups.

Damac District also enjoys full integration with the wider Damac Hills master development, which is known for its green open spaces, championship golf course, equestrian facilities, sports fields, and the Malibu Bay lagoon-style beach area. The interiors are finished with modern high-quality materials, equipped kitchens, and semi-furnished layouts that include built-in wardrobes where applicable. The overall concept focuses on combining practical, contemporary living with a refined residential standard within a nature-rich community setting.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
